name: Five Owls
source:
A visual novel telling the story of Veronica and her crazy adventure set in the 21st century in the beautiful city of Pińczów in Poland. The girl is a type of gaming loner who doesn't look for trouble - it finds her!

On her way, she unexpectedly meets five fascinating characters - Domarad, Helen, Rosalie, Naoyasu and... Johnny. Veronica doesn't know it yet, but this meeting will change her life forever.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2873540/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一部视觉小说，讲述了21世纪波兰美丽的平丘夫市维罗妮卡和她疯狂冒险的故事。这个女孩是一种游戏独行者，不会自找麻烦——麻烦会找到她！

途中，她意外地遇到了五个迷人的角色——多玛拉德、海伦、罗莎莉、直康和……约翰尼。维罗妮卡还不知道，这次会面将永远改变她的生活。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2873540/]Steam[/url]]
